title: Spicy Tempeh Stir-Fry with Noodles, Mushrooms, Bell Pepper & Broccoli

steps.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions. Drain in a colander and rinse.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Place in a large bowl.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, slice tempeh crosswise into thin strips. Add to the bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, tempeh, salt, and pepper; stir-fry until veggies are fork-tender, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
While the veggies are cooking, place soy sauce, water, chili-garlic sauce, and cornstarch in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the stir-fry sauce.
When the veggies are done, add sauce to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, 2-3 minutes more.
Meanwhile, trim green onions and cut crosswise into thin pieces.
Once the sauce has thickened, add drained noodles and green onions to the skillet. Toss to combine and continue to cook until warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
